# Persona — the enterprise security buyer

All required headings are present, so the only diagnostic is the off-allowlist
`marketing.type: lead`.

## Priority Initiatives

A SOC 2 audit is scheduled for next quarter and the team has no evidence trail.

## Success Factors

Every control maps to a dated piece of evidence a reviewer can open in one click.

## Perceived Barriers

Prior compliance tools became shelfware nobody kept current after the audit.

## Buyer's Journey

The security lead trials it against last year's audit findings before proposing budget.

## Decision Criteria

Deterministic checks, an audit-ready export, and no per-seat pricing surprise.
